description: A current-vs-previous comparison visual for Power BI — show two values side by side with the variance highlighted, ideal for period-over-period analysis where the change is the story. Codex Now vs Then takes the most common dashboard question — "how does this period compare to last period?" — and gives it a dedicated visual. Two values, the variance between them, and a directional indicator, all in one clean tile. IDEAL FOR Month-over-month, quarter-over-quarter, year-over-year comparisons Forecast vs actual at a glance Budget vs spend tiles Before-and-after dashboards (campaign launch, process change) Replacing two side-by-side cards plus a calculated difference card with one tile KEY FEATURES Dumbbell rows — a hollow ring for Then and a filled dot for Now, joined by a connector, with configurable labels for both Variance shown as percentage, absolute, or both Optional Target Range Low / High fields draw a translucent band per row, so you can see at a glance whether a metric sits inside, above, or below its acceptable range Configurable entry animation — duration and per-row stagger, or switch it off Directional indicator with up-is-good, down-is-good, or neutral logic Configurable colours for positive, negative, neutral states Full font controls on every text element Optional internal title with full font and alignment controls Hover tooltip showing now, then, and variance…
